source_name: Jinzai Service Comprehensive Site - licensed employment placement office search (yuryo shokugyo shokai jigyosha)
provider: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW); prefectural Labour Bureaus
temporal_coverage: current searchable registry; per-office permit date (kyoka nengappi) and expiration (yuko kikan manryobi) in detail records
record_unit: one licensed employment placement office per permit number (kyoka bango)
expected_bias: generic employment placement, NOT foreign-worker-specific (no foreign-worker filter); institutional/labor-market; over-represents recruitment/staffing firms; misses informal Chinese-oriented job brokerage
notes: authoritative source is a searchable web database with NO confirmed CSV/Excel/bulk download or API (portal homepage, Tokyo Labour Bureau page, and site help page all checked); site congested; per-record fields (permit number, address with municipality, permit date, expiration) are rich and would support observable-by-2024 inference and municipality linkage IF acquired, but reproducible bulk acquisition is unconfirmed and per-search scraping of a dynamic congested site is fragile and possibly terms-restricted; permit number first 2 digits encode issuing prefecture; CAO listshokai.pdf is a narrow subset, not comprehensive
